values.meaning: duration the protective zone blocks basic attacks

mechanics.claim: The zone blocks all non-turret basic attacks that hit Shen or allies in the area, but not ability damage in general.
mechanics.quote: blocking all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area

mechanics.claim: It also blocks damage from abilities that use basic attack damage (e.g. Lunge, Mystic Shot, Steel Tempest).
mechanics.quote: will also block damage from all abilities that use {{tip|basic damage}} ({{ai|Lunge|Fiora}}, {{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}, {{ai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo}})

mechanics.claim: The cooldown does not start until after the zone effect completes.
The zone can be moved while active if Shen uses Twilight Assault.
mechanics.quote: ''Spirit's Refuge's'' protective zone can be moved while active if '''Shen''' uses {{ai|Twilight Assault|Shen}}.
